name: Mambawakale
isnote: A large basal paracrocodylomorph, possibly a poposauroid (English Wikipedia); PBDB lists Pseudosuchia; placed there.
sum: Mambawakale is a large basal paracrocodylomorph, possibly a poposauroid, from the Anisian Manda Beds of Tanzania, informally called Pallisteria before publication.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
